step.cmd: In Curam, confirm that the Interruption of Earnings evidence states that no interruption has occurred as follows:

ul.li: From the Application Case, select the Evidence tab from the navigation bar.
From the Evidence Dashboard , select Evidence from the menu on the left-hand side.
From the Type column, locate the Application Receipt Details and select > to view the details obtained from the client’s application for benefits.
Under Interruption of Earnings Details , confirm that an interruption of earnings has not occurred .

step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to determine if they have reduced their self-employment activities by 40% or more.
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 4.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Finalize Claim BPNE 8 . Finalize Claim BPNE 8

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Curam claim. Interruption of earnings - SE.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the client had an interruption of earnings:

ul.li: If no, go to Finalize Claim BPNE 8 . Finalize Claim BPNE 8
If yes, go to Authorize the Application Case . Authorize the Application Case
